messages:
Alex H: FYI — hit a hard queue for reserved GPUs in eu-west1. We need 16 A100-equivalent for a 3-week eval starting 2026-05-04. Any ETA on reservations?
Maria C: Ack. I see the queue — lead time is 3–5 weeks right now. Ops has a partial pool but not 16 contiguous.
Cheng L: Can we split across zones or fall back to dedicated burst? Splitting hurts locality for KV cache but might be cheaper than on-demand.
Sophia R: tagging @ops-bot to get the live reservation snapshot and current holdlist.
ops-bot: Reservation queue snapshot: pending=28, awaiting-approval=7, free-pool-eu-west1=4, free-pool-us-west2=12. ETA estimate based on current churn: 21–35 days.
Jared P: Oof. This affects the PLG demo calendar. Is there any short-term paid option we can use to bridge?
Maria C: We can do a temporary dedicated burst (reserved commitment 1 month) in us-west2 and cross-region route traffic — ~20% higher latency but doable for demo. Cost delta ~+40% vs long-term reserved.
billing-bot: Preliminary cost for 1-month burst (16 A100-equivalent): est_monthly=$91,200; on-demand 1-month est=$128,700; 1-year reserve est/unit price~50% discount.
Alex H: For evaluation we prefer lower jitter over cost. If burst is available now, let's use burst in us-west2 and request region fallback in config. Also log the business reason for finance.
Cheng L: I'll open a ticket to request cross-region fallback policy: set `preferred_region: eu-west1`, `fallback: us-west2`, `max_latency_increase_ms: 80`. Snippet: ```yaml
inference_route:
  preferred_region: eu-west1
  fallback_regions: [us-west2]
  fallback_policy: prefer_localized_cache
```
Sophia R: Sending a direct message to cloud AM to accelerate the reservation — trying to compress lead time. Also proposing we add this eval to the high-priority holdlist so churn prioritizes it.
Maria C: Action items: 1) Cheng open infra ticket for fallback + rollout flag 2) Sophia contact cloud AM and add to holdlist 3) Alex + Jared to add business justification to finance ticket for 1-month burst 4) Ops to provision burst and validate KV cache behavior in us-west2.
Alex H: Thanks. Please ping me when the holdlist entry is created. :thumbsup:
Jared P: I'll draft the finance justification and post in #finance-review in 30m.
ops-bot: Holdlist entry created: id=HL-2026-051, priority=high, requested_by=Alex H. Reservation request created (burst): RB-184321-16-us-west2, status=pending-provision.
billing-bot: Note: If we later convert the burst to a 3-month commitment within 14 days, cloud provider may allow partial credit; keep records of RB id.
Maria C: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene if cloud AM can't move the queue. If not, we might reschedule the eval by 3 weeks.
Alex H: Understood. Closing for now — keep updates in this thread.
